set.smtpGmailStep1: Baara kɛ ni Gmail ye duguma — jatigila, port 587, ani TLS faw bɛ fa u yɛrɛma.
set.smtpGmailStep2: I ka Gmail dafalen don From email ani Username (misali la you@gmail.com).
set.smtpGmailStep3: I ka 2-Step Verification daminɛ i ka Google Account kɔnɔ, o kɔ i ka App Password dɔ da. Baara kɛ n’o tɔgɔlasɛbɛn ye yan — i kana kɛ i ka Gmail tɔgɔlasɛbɛn nɔgɔman ye.

set.smtpGmailStep5: Save digi nin ɲɛ in sanfɛ.

set.smtpWebStep1: Use Webmail digi jukɔrɔ — Hostinger ka defaults bɛ fa u yɛrɛma (smtp.hostinger.com, port 465, SSL). Jatigila Changer ni i bɛ baara kɛ ni furakɛlikɛla wɛrɛ ye.
set.smtpWebStep2: Hostinger: ka port 465 mara ni TLS ye (SSL). Dilanbaga tɔw fɛ, port 587 + Use TLS ye ko ye min ka ca.
set.smtpWebStep3: Fill From email, From name, baarakɛla tɔgɔ (imeyi dafalen), ani mailbox tɔgɔlasɛbɛn.
set.smtpWebStep4: Save digi nin ɲɛ in sanfɛ, o kɔ, i ka kɔrɔbɔli sɛbɛn dɔ ci.
